entries.german:
Bischof Wilhelm von Straßburg, Landgraf im Elsaß, bekundet, dass er dem Balthasar v. Rosenberg, Amtmann zu Lauterburg, als einem (Lehns)träger seiner Ehefrau Attala v. Ingelheim, der Tochter des verstorbenen Hans v. Ingelheim, das Dorf Gerolsheim bei Lambsheim zu einem Pfandlehen verliehen habe, wie es Balthasar Schmutzel v. Dirmstein, danach Jakob v. Fleckenstein als Träger seiner Ehefrau Barbara v. Ingelheim und ihrer Schwestern Ursula, Elisabeth und Attala innehatte, jedoch vorbehaltlich der Wiederlösung durch das Stift Straßburg

Siegler: Aussteller
entries.english:
Bishop Wilhelm of Strasbourg, Landgrave in Alsace, declares that he has enfeoffed Balthasar von Rosenberg, Amtmann of Lauterburg, as the (fief)holder for his wife Attala v. Ingelheim, daughter of the deceased Hans v. Ingelheim, with the village of Gerolsheim near Lambsheim as a Pfandlehen (pledge fief), as it was previously held by Balthasar Schmutzel v. Dirmstein, and subsequently by Jakob v. Fleckenstein as holder for his wife Barbara v. Ingelheim and her sisters Ursula, Elisabeth, and Attala, subject to redemption by the Strasbourg Minster chapter.

Sealer: Issuer

facts.content: received the village of Gerolsheim near Lambsheim as a Pfandlehen from Bishop Wilhelm of Strasbourg as Lehenträger for his wife Attala von Ingelheim, subject to redemption.
